name: Certificate Agent
summary: Certania — finds expired certificates month by month over the last 12 months (plus everything older) and those failing in the next 12 months, and tags their assets Cert failure : <Mon>-<DD>-<YYYY>. Expiry timeline, crown jewels, weak crypto and self-signed metrics, Cert Issue tagging by plugin, and an IoT/app cache fingerprinted from certs. Deterministic — no free-form LLM reasoning.
